To make juju mining potions from scratch, players are required to obtain samaden seeds and draconic vines for the potion. Therefore the players are required either one combination of requirements:
• Juju hunter potion, level 80 Farming, 80 Hunter, 74 Herblore, and either 80 Construction or 80,000 coins
• Juju hunter potion, level 90 Hunter
• Level 76 Farming, and level 80 Construction
Draconic vines are dropped by hunting draconic jadinkos in Herblore Habitat or on Anachronia, or harvesting produce from draconic jadinko on Anachronia Dinosaur Farm.
▸ Hunting jadinkos and Farming in Herblore Habitat for ingredients
For hunting draconic jadinkos, players need juju hunter potions. Players have to make some juju hunter potions first.
• Bring a hatchet and around 1,000 coins to Herblore Habitat.
• From Papa Mambo located in the northern section of the area, purchase some juju vials, a red blossom seed and 3–4 marasamaw plant traps. If the tool leprechaun or tool belt does not have a seed dibber, purchase these as well.
• Plant the red blossom seed in the vine flower patch located in the centre section of the area. This will cause common jadinkos to spawn in the northern area.
• Trap common jadinkos with the marasamaw plant traps until players have obtained samaden seeds and lergberry seeds. As these drops are random, players may have to trap more than 500 of them, be prepared.
• Once obtained, plant the samaden seed in the vine herb patch (a second herb patch is available to the east by crossing the large vine hanging over the water), the lergberry seed in the bush patch, and construct a dark pit in the construction spot. Adding some juju hunter potion to the red vine blossom will cause draconic jadinkos to spawn in the northern area of the activity area.…
Each ore-receiving swing has a 10% chance to gain a spirit of the corresponding ore.
